summary: Redesign the Owner Cart Show screen as a glanceable device home: connection states and direct power/show actions first, then lighting, independent motion and text controls. Preserve existing handlers, hidden data and score paths.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing static Owner PWA, three-view navigation, current command/status handlers and guest route. Presentation/layout only; no new runtime, backend, dependency, release gate, or device behavior.

Guest and deferred score/color views, existing IDs, storage, handlers, live score source, relay and permission rules remain.

scoped_evidence.summary: Show opens on a compact home screen with connection state and direct existing power/show actions, followed by lighting, independent motion and Text. Scores and System remain separate; hidden colors and saved looks retain their data.

owner_design_gate.selected_option: Compact field utility led by documented Local Roots cream, stone, soil, clay, sage and forest tones; retain HBNF green only as a restrained accent. Use one system sans family, functional headings and short status copy. Align frequent controls and state first, fit portrait and landscape without dead space, preserve independent Show motion, guest controls, deferred Scores/Colors/Saved Looks and all data paths.
